title: Neutral curves and traveling waves in plane Poiseuille flow
summary: We study the spectrum of the Orr--Sommerfeld operator associated with the incompressible plane Poiseuille flow in the high-Reynolds-number regime. In the Tollmien--Schlichting eigenvalue region, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the lower and upper branches of the neutral curve. For each sufficiently small fixed wavenumber $α$, the viscosities corresponding to the lower and upper neutral branches satisfy $ν\sim |α|^7$ and $ν\sim |α|^{11}$, respectively.
